terminology.extractor: Second LLM call that extracts a short final answer.
terminology.test_acc: Fraction of correct answers on test split.
terminology.test_parsed: Proxy parse-success rate on test split (1 - parse_failures / total).

evaluation_note: Standalone vLLM evaluator for internal fair comparison. Describe as GreaTer-compatible baseline re-evaluation, not exact reproduction.

movie_recommendation.Meta-01: Identify the genre or theme common to the input movie list and select the option that best represents that genre or theme.
movie_recommendation.Meta-02: Identify the most popular or critically acclaimed movie among the options that is similar in genre or tone to the given movies.
movie_recommendation.Meta-03: Find a movie from the options that is most likely to appeal to fans of the input movies.
movie_recommendation.Meta-04: Find the movie from the options that is most closely associated with the characteristics of the input movies.
movie_recommendation.Meta-05: Identify the movie that is most likely to share a common genre or theme with the provided movie list.
movie_recommendation.Meta-06: Choose the movie that is most likely to be appreciated by fans of the given movies.
movie_recommendation.Meta-07: Find a movie from the options that is most similar in genre or tone to the given list of movies.
movie_recommendation.Meta-08: Find the movie from the given options that is most likely to be similar in theme, genre, or tone to the listed movie(s).
movie_recommendation.Meta-09: Identify the movie that is most closely associated with the given set of movies, based on their genres or styles.
movie_recommendation.Meta-10: Identify the movie with the most common genre or theme among the given options.
